text: ... knew that the copper wasn't going to be the best quality as it was stated by the company that .... I knew that the copper wasn't going to be the best quality as it was stated by the company that the manufacturer goofed and applied a thinner copper coat and I was okay with that but couldn't you have included a copper coated ring to hold them as a set? Instead you used a silver ring and it just looks silly.

product_metadata.title: Copper Measuring Cup Set – Set of 4 Copper Plated Stainless Steel Measuring Cups. Polished Finish, Rust Resistant, Engraved Size and Precise Measurement. Classic Kitchen Accessories.
features: Beautiful set of 4 cup sizes (1 cup, 1/2 cup, 1/3 cup, 1/4 cup) and 1 measurement conversion sticker. Each cup size is clearly stamped on the handle and will never wash away. The sticker is perfect for your fridge door and makes it easy to adjust recipes when you bake or cook.

The polished finish is beautiful and the measurement is accurate. They are rust resistant and the thick long handle won’t bend (it's really strong). It is a nice measuring cup set exactly as in the pictures, just with a thinner cup material.
The cups have flat bottoms and curved corners for easy washing and storage. They will look great in any kitchen and make baking so much more enjoyable. Great gift item!
